what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect amount is a count of a creature's power (Count$CardPower) while that power is negative: the amount applied equals zero, not the negative number.
near_miss: The same count-of-power effect resolving while the creature's power is positive, applying its full power.
record_fields: resolution payload events (pt_change / damage_dealt / life_change amount)

what_to_detect: A combat in which a creature whose power is zero or less is a declared attacker or blocker and the combat events hold no damage_dealt from it (and no life gained by the opponent).
near_miss: A combat where a creature with positive power deals damage.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability whose amount is defined by the ability's own text (Count$...) where the applied amount equals the value the count has at resolution, not at activation.
near_miss: The same ability resolving with the count unchanged since activation.
record_fields: cost half state vs effect half state

what_to_detect: A trigger that refers to the X of another object (the cast spell that triggered it) firing, with the effect using the X that object was cast with.
near_miss: A trigger referring to another object's X whose effect amount is not the X that object was cast with.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose amount derives from the mana value of a card with {X} in its cost that is outside the stack, applying X = 0.
near_miss: The same effect applied to a spell on the stack, with X as announced.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate paying a mana cost of an object outside the stack that has {X}, treated as X = 0 (candidate affordable).
near_miss: A candidate whose cost-paid object has no {X}.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability a copy gained, whose X is the activation's X, not the copied card's X.
near_miss: A gained activated ability with {X} whose effect uses the copied or copying object's X instead of the X announced for the activation.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an activated ability with {X} in its cost, whose amount equals the X announced in that activation, independent of the X the permanent was cast with.
near_miss: An activated ability with {X} whose amount follows the X the permanent was cast with instead of the X announced for this activation.

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield with counters whose number equals the X of the spell that became the permanent.
near_miss: A permanent entering without having been cast (X = 0, no counters).
record_fields: resolution payload events (zone_change to battlefield, counter_change delta)

what_to_detect: An enters-the-battlefield trigger whose effect repeats or scales by the X of the spell that became the permanent.
near_miss: The same trigger when the permanent was put onto the battlefield without being cast (X = 0).

what_to_detect: A delayed triggered ability created by a spell whose effect count equals the X of the spell that created it.
near_miss: A delayed trigger whose effect count is not the X of the spell that created it.

what_to_detect: A playability decision candidate whose cost contains a snow mana symbol {S}, affordable only when snow sources pay it.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate whose cost symbol cannot be paid by the available mana (affordable false).
record_fields: candidate acting line mana cost / script Cost$

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost holds {T} that is affordable: its permanent is untapped and, if a creature, has been under its controller's control since the turn began.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost holds {T} that is not affordable because its permanent is tapped or is a summoning-sick creature.
record_fields: playability decision candidates verdict.affordable (CostPayment.canPayAdditionalCosts, which runs CostTap.canPay: canTap and not isAbilitySick)

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost holds {T} on a noncreature permanent that came under its controller's control this turn, affordable: summoning sickness does not restrict it.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost holds {T} on a summoning-sick creature, not affordable.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost holds {Q} that is affordable: its permanent is tapped and, if a creature, has been under its controller's control since the turn began.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost holds {Q} that is not affordable because its permanent is untapped or is a summoning-sick creature.
record_fields: playability decision candidates verdict.affordable (CostUntap.canPay: canUntap and not isAbilitySick)

what_to_detect: A leveler's level-range static (conditioned on its level counters lying in an N1-N2 range) contributing its P/T and keywords while the permanent's level counters are within the range.
near_miss: A leveler whose level counters are outside the range, its range static inactive and contributing nothing.

what_to_detect: A leveler's N+ level static (conditioned on its level counters being at least N) contributing its P/T and keywords while the permanent has N or more level counters.
near_miss: A leveler with fewer than N level counters, its N+ static inactive and contributing nothing.

what_to_detect: A Saga chapter ability evaluated when lore counters are added, firing when the count crosses from below its chapter number to at least it.
near_miss: A chapter ability evaluated on a lore counter being added whose chapter number the count did not cross, not firing.
record_fields: acting line script_text Chapter:N:... (keyword-derived, script_api_type Keyword, no Mode$, so trigger_mode's mode cannot match it)

what_to_detect: A triggered ability a Class gains at a level firing while the Class is at that level or higher.
near_miss: The same event while the Class is below that level, so the trigger is not on the Class and does not fire.
record_fields: acting line: the Class:N keyword line (the gained trigger is attached at runtime and has no Mode$ line of its own in the sidecar)

what_to_detect: A Class level bar candidate that can be played: the Class is at the level just below the bar's and the timing is sorcery speed.
near_miss: A Class level bar candidate that cannot be played because the Class is not at the previous level or the timing is not sorcery speed.
record_fields: candidate acting line: the Class:N keyword line (script_api_type Keyword; the runtime ability is ClassLevelUp)
gen-3 verdict.timing, failed_checks, card class level

what_to_detect: A spell with {X} in its mana cost cast without paying that cost, resolving with X = 0.
near_miss: The same spell cast paying its cost with X announced.

what_to_detect: A playability decision candidate whose cost contains a {C} symbol, affordable only with colourless mana.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate whose cost symbol cannot be paid by the available mana (affordable false).
record_fields: candidate acting line mana cost / script Cost$

what_to_detect: A playability decision candidate whose cost contains a two-colour hybrid symbol, affordable with mana of either colour.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate whose cost symbol cannot be paid by the available mana (affordable false).
record_fields: candidate acting line mana cost / script Cost$

what_to_detect: A playability decision candidate whose cost contains monocolored hybrid {2/C} symbols, affordable with one coloured or two other mana.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate whose cost symbol cannot be paid by the available mana (affordable false).
record_fields: candidate acting line mana cost / script Cost$

what_to_detect: A playability decision candidate whose cost contains a Phyrexian symbol, affordable by paying 2 life instead of mana.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate whose cost symbol cannot be paid by the available mana (affordable false).
record_fields: candidate acting line mana cost / script Cost$
